title: poa annua var. supina
intro: Poa annua var. supina, commonly known as False Bermuda Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce the risk of infection. The therapeutic actions of Poa annua var. supina include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
